parameters.label: The route: to the safest beacon, then one priority raise per beacon at risk and the core's dig depth (none by default)

why: Easy, seat 0, round 1, seed 0x00000000ca5caded (recorded; Easy draws nothing at random). Power is not short, so nothing is raised: move to the safest beacon and stay with it. Then set the core b_00 to dig 4 voxels deep, so its starting drone keeps working its seam below the top layer.
